title: DJI Import
empty.title: No camera connected
empty.help: Plug in your DJI camera and choose Transfer mode, or insert its card.
empty.unmounted: %1 is connected, but no card is mounted. Choose Transfer mode on the camera.
dest.exists: Existing folder: new files go into date folders, and nothing in it is overwritten.
dest.willCreate: This folder will be created on the first import.
opt.photosHelp: JPG and DNG stills go next to the clips.
opt.proxiesHelp: Low-res copies the camera records; handy as editing proxies.
opt.moveHelp: Each file is deleted only after its copy is re-read and verified.
result.ejected: Ejected. It's safe to unplug the card.
result.unmounted: Unmounted. It's safe to unplug the card.

clean.confirm.one:
Remove %1 imported file (%2) from the card?

It is first checked byte for byte against its copy in %3 and stays on the card if they differ. Files that are not imported yet are never touched.
clean.confirm.other:
Remove %1 imported files (%2) from the card?

Each is first checked byte for byte against its copy in %3 and stays on the card if they differ. Files that are not imported yet are never touched.

clean.buttonProxies.one: Clean up card: %1 leftover LRF proxy
clean.buttonProxies.other: Clean up card: %1 leftover LRF proxies

clean.confirmProxies.one: Its %1 LRF proxy (a low-res copy the camera makes) is removed too.
clean.confirmProxies.other: Their %1 LRF proxies (low-res copies the camera makes) are removed too.

clean.confirmOnlyProxies.one:
Remove %1 leftover LRF proxy from the card?

It is a low-res copy the camera made of a clip that is already in %2.
clean.confirmOnlyProxies.other:
Remove %1 leftover LRF proxies from the card?

They are low-res copies the camera made of clips that are already in %2.

result.cancelled: Import cancelled; nothing partial was left behind.
